text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status... 'Fear'. Is my tail still 
attached?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There, there. It's still firmly attached, 
so please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! That tiny lightning won't reach 
all the way here, so you are safe now!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... Bourbon-chan's class had 
a presentation session for independent 
science research, and—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Our group's theme is simply: 'Let's Make 
Lightning'!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
We will now generate miniature lightning 
inside this light bulb! Please watch 
closely, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This lightning is artificial; evasive 
maneuvers unnecessary. This lightning is 
artificial; evasive maneuvers—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Emergency routine activated. Before I 
realized it, I had executed an emergency 
withdrawal.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
And then, I found Bourbon-chan crouched 
down at the end of the hallway.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Due to this incident, unforeseen 
processing load was imposed upon Bakushin 
O-san and my group members.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The fact that 'artificial lightning does 
not take tails' was already logged into 
memory. However—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Scary things are scary! That is only 
natural!! Besides, our group's 
presentation concluded successfully thanks 
to my outstanding efforts as class 
president!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, my insufficiency remains an 
issue. Unless I overcome lightning, system 
errors will recur.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Resistance against lightning... How should 
I proceed?
choice_data_list:
You'll just have to get used to it step by 
step...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, that is the standard 
protocol. I shall borrow the experiment 
kit from class and execute the procedure.
choice_data_list: Are you going to be okay?
Are you going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, pushing yourself too far is 
strictly prohibited! You were so terribly 
frightened before!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I will run trials with lightning on a 
smaller scale than the class demo. That 
should reduce mental strain.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
If she's motivated, I'd love to cheer her 
on. It could be a great chance for 
payback.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing Mission 'Lightning 
Training'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sh-sh-shiver...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, and let's take a slow, deep 
breath, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sh-sh-sh-shiver...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon-chan, fight on! We'll be right by 
your side the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You are a strong horse girl! There is no 
need to fear mere lightning!
choice_data_list: That's right, give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(Right. I have everyone by my side. I will 
absolutely—)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Complete the mission...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
M-Mission complete... Successfully stared 
directly at the artificial lightning.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!! You did it, Bourbon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While not a total conquest, it 
represents one step forward.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of you, I gained courage. 
One day, I will surely conquer lightning.

With her steadfast resolution, Mihono 
Bourbon looked far more dependable than 
before her training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Kgh... My apologies. It appears—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's okay. I'll hold your hand nice and 
tight.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Let's share the fear together like this, 
okay? If we do, see? It'll gradually 
become less scary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Laurel-san...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Respiration and heart rate normalized. 
Perspiration levels returned to baseline. 
...No status fluctuations detected when 
viewing the miniature lightning.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!! You did it, Bourbon-san!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While not a total conquest, it 
represents one step forward.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is all thanks to Laurel-san's coping 
protocol. I express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome. Do you think you can 
keep up the lightning training from now 
on?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. One day, I will surely conquer 
lightning.

With her steadfast resolution, Mihono 
Bourbon looked far more dependable than 
before her training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My tail?
choice_data_list: A strong tail might not get taken away.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! What a splendid idea! Allow me to 
join in as well!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing Mission 'Lightning 
Training': Tail conditioning phase.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
First, preparation. After wrapping those 
weights around the entirety of the tail, 
we will execute squats.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! They look exceptionally heavy! The 
bakushin-grade effectiveness is 
indisputable!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next after strength training is shuttle 
runs. —Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nuooooh!! Let us keep up this momentum!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Great work, you two! Even with those 
weights on, you were both so fast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I-It might just be my 
imagination, but my tail feels far 
brawnier than before training!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The grip firmness is distinctly 
different.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
While the fear of lightning is not yet 
overcome, these results provide 
reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I express my gratitude to Bakushin O-san 
for training alongside me and offering 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
One day, I will surely forge a tail that 
will never yield to lightning.

With her steadfast resolution, Mihono 
Bourbon looked far more dependable than 
before her training.
